name: Checkbox
description: Checkboxes allow users to select one or more items from a set. Checkboxes can turn an option on or off.

states.name: Indeterminate
states.description: Partially selected state for parent checkboxes

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether or not the checkbox is selected

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Whether or not the checkbox is in an indeterminate state

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the checkbox must be selected for form submission

props.name: value
props.description: The value submitted with the form when checked

props.name: name
props.description: The HTML name for form submission

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when the checkbox state changes

events.name: input
events.description: Fired when the checkbox receives input

accessibility.screenReaderNotes: Announce checkbox label, checked state, and indeterminate state. Always provide aria-label for checkboxes without visible labels.
accessibility.focusManagement: Receives focus in tab order. Focus ring visible on keyboard focus.

llm.intent: Allow users to make binary or multiple selections from a list
allowedContexts: Bulk selection in tables or lists
forbiddenContexts: Single selection from mutually exclusive options (use radio instead)
Binary toggles better suited for switch
antiPatterns: Checkbox without visible or accessible label
Using checkbox for mutually exclusive options
Checkbox for simple on/off toggle (use switch)
Not using indeterminate state for parent checkboxes
llm.semanticMeaning: Selection control for binary or multiple choices
